decision_rationale: The record describes CellWhisperer as a new multimodal model for scRNA-seq exploration with natural language, not a review or wrapper. It explicitly combines transcriptome profiles with biological text and a chat interface for interactive investigation.
evidence_snippet: "multimodal AI model that combines transcriptome profiles with an understanding of biological text"; "natural-language chat functionality"; "paired transcriptomes and text"; "free-text queries"
